versions.description_html:
Learn how Business Central Fabric Integration works, connect your ERP data to OneLake, and avoid common analytics pitfalls in Microsoft's cloud ecosystem.

Your accounting system is the worst place to answer the big questions about your business. That sounds backwards, because Business Central already holds every number that matters.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Business Central Really Is
  • What Fabric and OneLake Are
  • Why Analytics Live Outside the ERP
  • Three Ways the Data Gets Across
  • What the Flow Looks Like
  • What Usually Goes Wrong
  • When You Need It and When You Don't
  • A Quick Recap and One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Why Your Business Central Won't Scale to Finance & Operations
  • Monitor Business Central Telemetry with Power BI
  • More Data & Fabric episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Data & Fabric: the most-listened episodes
